name: Devizes Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Devizes Community Centre. Open Mon and Thu 10am-2pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Wiltshire Council Allotments
short_description: Wiltshire Council allotment sites in Devizes area
description: Council manages sites at Devizes and nearby villages. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Devizes Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Hillworth Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Historic park setting.
